targets.name: bb6_antihydra
targets.title: Antihydra (BB6 Cryptid)
targets.summary: Famous BB(6) Collatz-like cryptid discovered by mxdys (2024). Submit an exact halting step witness or verified non-halting recurrence proof.
targets.approach: Submit a verified halting step certificate (resolution=proved) or exact inductive recurrence certificate (resolution=disproved).

targets.name: bb6_kropitz_champ
targets.title: Kropitz BB(6) Tetrational Machine
targets.summary: Pavel Kropitz's hyper-exponential 6-state 2-symbol machine exceeding 10^^15 steps. Open for inductive non-halting refutation or halting witness.
targets.approach: Submit a verified halting step certificate (resolution=proved) or exact inductive recurrence certificate (resolution=disproved).

targets.name: bb6_marxen_buntrock_ext
targets.title: BB(6) Counter Cryptid (Holdout C)
targets.summary: Long-running 6-state 2-symbol Turing machine exhibiting complex exponential counter dynamics from a blank tape.
targets.approach: Submit a verified halting step certificate (resolution=proved) or exact inductive recurrence certificate (resolution=disproved).

targets.name: bb6_kropitz_2010
targets.title: Kropitz 2010 BB(6) Holdout (Holdout D)
targets.summary: Pavel Kropitz's 2010 6-state 2-symbol exponential runner. Verify halting or submit an exact inductive non-halting recurrence certificate.
targets.approach: Submit a verified halting step certificate (resolution=proved) or exact inductive recurrence certificate (resolution=disproved).

targets.name: bb6_halting_steps
targets.title: BB(6) Direct-Replay Halting Champion
targets.summary: Find a 6-state 2-symbol Turing machine that halts from a blank tape after strictly more steps (verified by exact replay up to 25M steps).
targets.approach: Submit any valid 6-state 2-symbol 1RB machine halting in strictly more steps than the current holder (up to 25,000,000 CI replay cap).

targets.name: bb6_ones_written
targets.title: Sigma(6) Direct-Replay Ones Champion
targets.summary: Find a 6-state 2-symbol halting Turing machine leaving strictly more 1s on the tape at halt (verified by exact replay up to 25M steps).
targets.approach: Submit any valid 6-state 2-symbol 1RB halting machine leaving strictly more 1s on the tape than the current holder.
